def data1 : Data where
  size := 133
  phase v := (meta1.getD v 0)%7
  last v := (meta1.getD v 0)/7%19
  low v := (meta1.getD v 0)/133
  next u bit := nextCodes1.getD (2*u+bit) 0

def ranking1 : Ranking where
  component := component1
  cyclic c := decide (childCode1 c ≠ 0)
  weight c := if childCode1 c=0 then 1 else jobBound (childCode1 c-1)
  rank c := ranks1.getD c 0
  bound := jobBound 1
